findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_provider, check_regulator, get_chain, get_token, get_base_pack · Private data: search_providers, get_provider, stablecoin_rails, find_corridor, get_examples, check_regulator, get_chain, get_token, get_base_pack · Public sink: find_corridor · Destructive: check_address_format.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_provider, check_regulator, get_chain, get_token, get_base_pack · Private data: search_providers, get_provider, stablecoin_rails, find_corridor, get_examples, check_regulator, get_chain, get_token, get_base_pack · Public sink: find_corridor · Destructive: check_address_format

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
